audience: Shopify merchants who take bookings with Appointo

useCases.title: See upcoming or past bookings
useCases.text: The AI lists bookings, upcoming or past or by search, with time, product, duration, quantity, price and the customers' name, email and phone.

useCases.title: Find open time slots for a service
useCases.text: The AI lists the bookable products and their services, then reads the open time slots of one service from a start date.

useCases.title: Review cancelled bookings
useCases.text: The AI lists cancelled bookings with time, product and customers, so you can see what was cancelled and for which service.

useCases.title: Review recurring booking subscriptions
useCases.text: The AI lists subscription contracts of customers who repeat appointments, searched by product, variant, order number or customer name.

useCases.title: Book a customer into an open slot
useCases.text: The AI checks the open slots of a service and creates a booking for a customer at the slot you choose. Appointo may email the customer.

useCases.title: Reschedule or cancel a booking, or set its buffer times
useCases.text: The AI checks open slots, moves a booking to a new slot, cancels it or only some of its customers, or sets the minutes blocked before and after it.
